utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have you had a chance to look over the inventory list? I'm really worried we might be missing some crucial items.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven't seen the list yet, sorry. I only just heard about the drive from Cleo. What items are you worried about?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm most concerned about the nails and lumber—we're going to need a lot to patch up the fences, and I don't know if we've accounted for that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the repair drive at the community center this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, I've been spreading the word! It's going to be a great community effort.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'm so glad you're helping spread the word! I think it's going to be really helpful for a lot of folks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Flyers would be perfect, Quinn! I'll help pass them out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great idea, Nell! Do you think we could also include a map to the school parking lot on the flyer?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely, Jules! I'll make sure to add that map when I print the copies.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, there's a repair drive this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. I'm bringing my old blender.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, great! I'll be there—got my toolbox ready. What else can we fix?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard some folks are bringing lamps and toasters. Should be a productive day!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So Mina, are we focusing on the community center and playground repairs, or is this the same repair drive Mara mentioned for household items?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, I thought it was just general repairs? I heard it's at the community center parking lot on Saturday. Not sure about the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think Mara mentioned household items, but Mina said community center and playground. Maybe we should check with Mara or Mina to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Kira, are you interested in coming to the repair drive this Saturday? We could use extra hands!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure the community center has enough supplies? I heard Tess mention it, but I don't want to waste time if we're short on things.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Don't worry, Kira! We've got plenty of tools and materials. Your help would be really valuable.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The repair drive starts at 10 AM sharp, as always. I'll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Eli. I'll be there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: See you then, Sam.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, Mina! Are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? I'm also coordinating a pickup for items on Tuesday if you want to help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I'm planning to be there on Saturday. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's from 10 to 2 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's... um, was it today? Sorry, my memory is like a sieve.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, Oren, I believe it's at the Oak Street community center. Eli mentioned it earlier.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Oak Street! Right, I remember now. Thanks, Opal, I'd have walked all over town looking for it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, any word on that repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think I saw a flyer, but I'm not sure if it's this weekend or last month.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, Oren forgot about it too. We really need to get it sorted soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Do you have that list of materials we're short on, Mara?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I've got it right here. We're mostly short on small screws and solder.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I'll add those to my inventory. How many screws do we need exactly?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, need any tools for the repair drive? I've got a full set in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No tools needed, Gus. Just a jump start if you've got cables.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got jump cables in my truck—I'll bring 'em right over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm bringing my old blender.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great, Vik! We'll have a team there to fix it up and find it a new home. See you Saturday at 10 in the community center parking lot!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Awesome, can't wait to see you there at 10! I'll have my blender ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Pia, do you know the exact time for the repair drive? I need to plan my day.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure of the exact time, Eli. Maybe we should ask Quinn; they're organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good idea, Pia. Let's go find Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Nell, I was wondering if you could lend a hand with my fence during the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'd love to help, but I'm not much of a handywoman. What do you need done?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, it's just a loose panel that needs nailing back. If you could hold it steady while I hammer, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I, uh, I think I left the tools somewhere... Sorry, my mind's gone blank again.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You lost the tools? We can't even start without them. Are you sure you're up for this?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I know, I know... I'll retrace my steps, I promise. Maybe I left them in the garage?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. Meet you by the truck.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Did you need any tools for the repair drive? I have some I could bring.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No, just a jump start. Thanks anyway.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, how's the repair drive planning going? Need any help with the logistics?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh Jules, it's a bit of a mess—Oren forgot all about the drive. We really need to get on that.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh no, Oren forgot? Well, I'm happy to help sort things out. Maybe we can all meet up to plan?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got plenty of tools if you need anything for the repair drive, Mara. Just say the word and I'll grab 'em.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus! Some screwdrivers and pliers would be great. Bring them along Saturday morning around 10.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good. What sizes of screwdrivers do you need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm checking the inventory now. Do you have a list of materials we're short on?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don't have a formal list, but Gus said he's got tools. Maybe we should start there?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good, let's track what Gus has. Can you help me make a list of what we're missing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think it's at the community center on Oak Street, same as last time. Are you planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I'm planning to go! I've got a broken toaster I've been meaning to get fixed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll see you there! Do you know what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, this Saturday? I thought it was next month...

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No, it's this Saturday! I've already got a bunch of neighbors on board, and we're all set with tools and supplies. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, this Saturday? I might have some time... what time does it start again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Let me grab my cables from the trunk.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, are those for the repair drive? Every bit helps!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, Leo's truck needs a jump start. Figured these cables would come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, Uli, I can take a look at your fence after we sort out the repair drive materials.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Dane, did Mara or Mina mention what specific materials we need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Not yet, Hana. I just got here—mind filling me in on what we're missing?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
